title: Real Research Today: Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0.
description:
The road to Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0 is already being paved. Animal communication AI (Project CETI on sperm whales, Earth Species Project) decodes nonhuman signals. Meta's EMG wristband and Neuralink's implants advance neural input devices.

Volumetric video capture (Microsoft Mixed Reality Capture) records full-3D performances. Together these programs form the fiber builds foundation that Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0 will build on — the coop logistics results, the member funding methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as coop logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Rural Broadband Co-ops 2.0 — next-gen co-ops wiring rural areas.

Phase 1 — Prove (fiber builds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (coop logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (member funding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (terrain): coop hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rural-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
